records.title: Kunchitiga sub-caste inclusion in central OBC list
details: The modalities for inclusion or exclusion of any case or community in/from the Central list of socially and educationally backward classes, as per provision of Srticle 343A (2) of the Constitution is under consideration of the Government but are yet to be finalized.

records.title: National Research foundation
details: In pursuance of Budget Announcement 2019, Government is in process for setting up of National Research Foundation (NRF).Modalities for formation of NRF including its funding strategy are presently being dliberated at the level of the Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India in consultation with NITI Aayog and other stakeholders.
